name: Hayakawa Naoki
source: A classmate of Kokone’s who has a one sided crush on her. Because of this he worries whenever she starts getting involved with Kazuhiro. He seems to be a polite person who insists on being reasonable, and when he has to give up for a reason that makes sense to him, he can step aside.
